This online update presents the latest three complete months that are common to
the declared CVD-event and mortality releases. It uses complete, frozen copies
of those two public release datasets only.

```{ojs}
//| output: false
eventMetrics = FileAttachment("data/event_release.csv").csv({typed: true})
mortalityMetrics = FileAttachment("data/mortality_release.csv").csv({typed: true})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
isPublishedNumber = row => {
  const status = String(row?.suppression_status ?? "").trim().toLowerCase()
  const value = Number(row?.display_value)
  return (status === "" || status === "none" || status === "not_applicable") && Number.isFinite(value)
}
monthKey = row => String(row.period_year).padStart(4, "0") + "-" + String(row.period_month).padStart(2, "0")
monthSerial = key => {
  const [year, month] = key.split("-").map(Number)
  return year * 12 + month
}
complete = row => String(row.period_complete) === "1"
onlyOne = (rows, label) => {
  if (rows.length !== 1) throw new Error(label + ": expected one public row per month.")
  return rows[0]
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
eventRows = eventMetrics.filter(row =>
  row.metric_id === "CVD-BURDEN-001" && row.period_type === "monthly" &&
  row.event_type === "all_cvd" && row.sex === "all" && row.age_group === "all" &&
  row.ascertainment_scope === "hospital_only" && row.statistic === "monthly_count"
)
mortalityRows = mortalityMetrics.filter(row =>
  row.metric_id === "MORT-BURDEN-001" && row.period_type === "monthly" &&
  row.event_type === "all_cvd" && row.sex === "all" && row.age_group === "all" &&
  row.case_definition === "primary_clear_likely" && row.statistic === "monthly_count"
)
eventByMonth = d3.rollup(eventRows, rows => onlyOne(rows, "Events"), monthKey)
mortalityByMonth = d3.rollup(mortalityRows, rows => onlyOne(rows, "Mortality"), monthKey)
commonMonths = Array.from(eventByMonth.keys()).filter(key => mortalityByMonth.has(key)).sort()
eligibleMonths = commonMonths.filter(key => isPublishedNumber(eventByMonth.get(key)) &&
  isPublishedNumber(mortalityByMonth.get(key)) && complete(eventByMonth.get(key)) && complete(mortalityByMonth.get(key)))
windowMonths = eligibleMonths.slice(-3)
windowIsConsecutive = windowMonths.length === 3 &&
  monthSerial(windowMonths[1]) === monthSerial(windowMonths[0]) + 1 &&
  monthSerial(windowMonths[2]) === monthSerial(windowMonths[1]) + 1
updateRows = windowIsConsecutive ? windowMonths.map(month => ({
  month,
  events: Number(eventByMonth.get(month).display_value),
  deaths: Number(mortalityByMonth.get(month).display_value)
})) : []
```

## Headline

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const result = document.createElement("p")
  if (!windowIsConsecutive) {
    result.textContent = "The declared releases do not contain three complete, consecutive and comparable published months."
    return result
  }
  const events = d3.sum(updateRows, row => row.events)
  const deaths = d3.sum(updateRows, row => row.deaths)
  const start = d3.utcFormat("%B %Y")(new Date(updateRows[0].month + "-01T00:00:00Z"))
  const end = d3.utcFormat("%B %Y")(new Date(updateRows[2].month + "-01T00:00:00Z"))
  result.textContent = `${events.toLocaleString("en-GB")} hospital-recorded CVD events and ${deaths.toLocaleString("en-GB")} CVD deaths were published for the three-month period from ${start} to ${end}.`
  return result
}
```

## Published monthly counts

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
updateRows.length ? Inputs.table(updateRows.map(row => ({
  Month: d3.utcFormat("%B %Y")(new Date(row.month + "-01T00:00:00Z")),
  "Hospital-recorded CVD events": row.events,
  "CVD deaths (primary definition)": row.deaths
}))) : "No comparable three-month table is available."
```
